name: Council of AI
description: Independent AI-governance measurement. Publishes a living 22-axis GSPC board, Ed25519-signed measurement cards, and a signed Merkle root. Measurement, not certification.

free_forever.principle: Reading the board and verifying a card are free and always will be. Nothing in this block returns a payment challenge.

doors.what: the living 22-axis board with derived totals
verify a signed card — VALID, INVALID or UNCHECKABLE
what is signed, what is anchored, what is neither

mcp.warning: Superseded registry versions advertise csoai-gspc-mcp.nicholastempleman.workers.dev/mcp, which returns 404. Use the canonical remote above.

paid.principle: Assembly and attestation may be priced. A grade is never sold, and no amount is published as static bytes. The price is quoted in the live 402 challenge at request time.

what_this_does_not_establish: The Council of AI measures and does not certify. It is not a notified body and issues no conformity mark.
Appearing on the board is not an endorsement, and absence from it is not a finding.
UNMEASURED is a first-class state and is published rather than hidden.
